/scripts.value:
on DeleteFromTrash
	local tDataA, tTarget, tQuizlisTable,tCollectionsTable,tTheID
	
	put authedUserQuizzesTable into tQuizlisTable
	put authedUserQuizCollectionsTable into tCollectionsTable
	
	put cdb_tableID(authedUserQuizzesTable) into tQuizlisTable
	put cdb_tableID(authedUserQuizCollectionsTable) into tCollectionsTable
	
	repeat with xQuizli = 1 to item 2 of the extents of lastDeleteFromTrashcan["quizlis"]
		put lastDeleteFromTrashcan["quizlis"][xQuizli] into tTheID
		put empty into tDataA[tQuizlisTable][tTheID]
	end repeat
	
	repeat with xCollection = 1 to item 2 of the extents of lastDeleteFromTrashcan["collections"]
		put lastDeleteFromTrashcan["collections"][xCollection] into tTheID
		put empty into tDataA[tCollectionsTable][tTheID]
	end repeat
	
	cdb_batchDelete tDataA,"cloud"	
	cdb_batchDelete tDataA,"local"	
end DeleteFromTrash
